purpose: Simpler orange-background and green-tray concept mockups, preserving the user's selected composition

variants.label: A — Smooth molded
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: simplified macOS application icon mockup for TrayNook.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and source of exact composition, palette, character, and pose: the curled tanuki hugging a green inbox tray on an apricot-orange squircle. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: a screenshot showing Keka's smooth simplified mascot icon. Use only its economy of detail and soft smooth forms. Do not copy the Keka character, armadillo shape, screenshot UI, search field, typography, or background.
Primary request: simplify Image 1 substantially, keeping its charming sleeping curled tanuki hugging the tray. Preserve orange/apricot squircle background, brown/copper animal with cream cheeks and dark eye patches, green inbox tray with pale green rim and visible central notch. Keep the same orientation: head reclining toward upper left, two paws embracing the tray, curled body on the right, broad solid fluffy-tail silhouette across lower foreground. Its expression stays eyes-closed and content. Short muzzle and small rounded ears stay tanuki-like. One head, two ears, two front paws. This is a reclining curled animal, not a sitting animal.
CRITICAL SIMPLIFICATION: remove every visible strand of fur, fuzzy edges, skin pores, grain, brushed textures, microdetail, realistic material finish, sharp reflections, toe lines, tiny highlights and excessive seams. Make edges smooth clean curves. Face uses only broad dark eye patches, two simple closed-eye arcs, small dark nose and a tiny smile. Paws are simple rounded mittens. Tail is one large uninterrupted smooth comma shape with no stripes or individual hairs.
Constraints: one complete centered squircle application icon; all subject parts inside tile. No text, labels, numerals, mockup grids, extra objects, UI screenshots or watermark. No ivory, blue or navy background. Retain green tray, orange backdrop and original curled hugging pose; change the rendering style only. Square output with narrow neutral margin outside the squircle.
Style variant A: smooth softly molded forms, as economical in surface detail as the Keka reference. Matte satin continuous surfaces with a single broad soft light-to-shadow transition per large part. Almost flat low relief; no fur whatsoever. Rounded head, body and tail feel like clean simple clay shapes without texture. Preserve a little native macOS dimensionality but make the rendering far simpler than Image 1. Tray is two or three clean green planes, no texture, only a gentle contact shadow. Flat warm apricot background, very slight tile edge shading.
